Third-party libraries used only for "Export" (loaded on demand, never at startup):

- jspdf.umd.min.js: jsPDF 4.2.1, MIT licence, https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js: jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.9, MIT licence, https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable
- xlsx.mini.min.js: SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5, Apache 2.0 licence, https://sheetjs.com (used only to write files, never to read uploaded ones)
